question_text: A 42-year-old woman comes to the clinic with a complaint of a severely itchy and painful rash on her hands and legs for a day. On physical examination, a prominent rash along with multiple blisters is noted on the ventral aspect of her right forearm. A photograph of the rash is shown. Which of the following is the most likely reaction that the patient is experiencing?
